description: This is a shell script used for testing the error handling of 'git update-ref' commands within a git project. It defines several test functions and test cases to validate different scenarios involving creating, updating, deleting, and conflicting references, including error cases and symbolic reference handling.

methods.name: test_update_rejected
methods.description: Test for handling errors when updating references with various conditions, including existing prefixes and conflicts.

methods.name: df_test
methods.description: Test for handling quick creation, deletion, and conflict resolution involving D/F references, including symbolic refs.
